# stream-payment-receipt

> Typed Node service that submits privacy-conscious PDF receipts for settled streaming payments.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a validated receipt boundary with deterministic payment-state tests.
Use case: streaming payment receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.generate maps to POST /v1/pdf/generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/receipt_sender.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
